concentration-curl.criteria: Seated, torso leaned forward, upper arm supported at inner thigh, supinated single dumbbell curl with fixed elbow and free hand on opposite knee. Controlled return; repeat on other side.

face-pull.criteria: Eye-height cable, rope attachment, stable stance and torso. Pull rope toward face, separating hands outside face with elbows moving out/back. Controlled return; constant rope lengths.

cable-upright-row.criteria: Low pulley straight bar, pronated grip, lead with elbows while lifting in front of torso, upper arms no higher than shoulder level. Controlled return without torso swing.

limits: Procedural simplified anatomy, clothes and equipment. Not full mesh collision or biomechanics certification. One-sided curl demonstration; repeat opposite side. Physical device and production pending.
